desc:
Sell 1,000,000 Kanom Krok!

They say if you sell Kanom Krok for $1 each and sell a million in one day, that’s $1,000,000 a day! Your little Thai street stall starts with a simpler goal: sell your first pancake.

🍳 How to Play
1. Walk up to your stove and select Cook.
2. Pick up the jug and pour coconut batter into the empty holes in the pan.
3. When the edges turn golden, use your spoon to scoop each pancake onto the tray. Customers will walk up and buy them!
4. Spend your earnings on a bigger pan and tray. Start with 7 holes, then upgrade to 16 and 37.
5. Hire staff to keep cooking while you make deliveries or visit the Temple Festival.
Ready for a new recipe? Try Ba Bin, a Thai coconut pancake you cook on a flat griddle. Pour the batter, flip each piece, then scoop it onto the tray.

🔥 Can you sell 1,000,000 Kanom Krok?
